name: neoplanner
description: Keeps a project's OpenSpec planning behind one agent, neoplanner:agent, so the main conversation's context stays free for code. You run the wrapped OpenSpec commands (propose, explore, update, sync, archive) and they run inside the agent; Claude sends it JSON requests to plan, revise and report progress, checked by hooks against a contract, and reads the artifacts it writes. The specs live in the repo's openspec/ folder, or in stealth mode in an OpenSpec store outside it. Requires the openspec CLI.
